g.text: FRANK LLOYD WRIGHT (1950) · T. HEINZ AIA
1 · LONGITUDINAL SECTION A–A — SW CANTILEVER PROW OVER LAKE MAHOPAC TO EAST MASTER WING (SCALE 1:150)
2 · CROSS SECTION B–B — WHALE ROCK ENTRY, KITCHEN BOULDER, ATRIUM CRANE MURAL & DINING (SCALE 1:150)
KITCHEN ROCK SHELF + LE CREUSET POTS
RL-10A: SECTION A-A — BATTERED PROW PARAPET & HEXAGONAL LAKE PIER
RL-10B: SECTION B-B — WHALE ROCK CLIFF & WHITE-CURBED SKYLIGHTS
▲ REDLINE RL-10 · REV P03.1 AS-BUILT FIELD VERIFICATION
SECTION A-A REDLINE: Deleted glass guardrail at SW Prow; added 16° outward-battered Buff-Stucco Parapet & 18° Copper Fascia.
SECTION B-B REDLINE: Added exterior NW Whale Rock stratified granite ledges & raised white skylight curb platform (+8.18m).
